question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'doubtful' from the following sentence.**

He was in a dilemma about the completion of the project investigation because of his health issues.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'uncertain.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Doubtful"** means uncertain or unsure about something. (संदिग्‍ध या अनिश्चित)

 
 
• **Example**: *The teacher is **doubtful**__ about having parents working as classroom assistants.*
 
 
 
• **"Dilemma"** means a situation in which you have to make a difficult choice between two or more things. (दो या अधिक वस्तुओं में से एक का चयन करने की कठिन स्थिति, दुविधा, असमंजस)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The president is clearly in a **dilemma**__ about how to tackle the crisis.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of **"Doubtful"** is **"Dilemma."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Completion:** the act of finishing something; not a synonym of doubtful. (काम पूरा करने की क्रिया या काम के पूरा हो जाने की स्थिति; समाप्ति; संपन्‍नता)
 
• **Project: **a planned piece of work; not a synonym of doubtful. (परियोजना, प्रकल्‍प; योजनाबद्घ और सावधानी से व्‍यवस्थित कार्य जिसमें प्रायः अनेक लोगों की भागीदारी होती है)
 
• **Investigation:** the process of carrying out a systematic inquiry; not a synonym of doubtful. (किसी स्थिति, अपराध आदि से संबंधित तथ्‍यों की आधिकारिक जाँच, अन्‍वेषण कार्य, छान-बीन, तफ़तीश, तहक़ीक़ात)
